rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken pattern for saying that two things are unlike.

example.jyutping: ngo5 tung4 nei5 m4 tung4 wo3

rows.note: Use this when a person disagrees with an opinion, suggestion, or statement.

example.english: I differ with you; I don't agree with doing that.
example.jyutping: ngo5 m4 tung4 ji3 nei5 gam2 zou6
